headline: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals acquires Aequitas Healthcare
sum: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited announced the acquisition of Aequitas Healthcare Private Limited, disclosed to NSE under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Rules on 29 June 2026.
detail: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals, a publicly listed pharmaceutical company, has acquired Aequitas Healthcare Private Limited through a transaction disclosed to the National Stock Exchange (NSE). The acquisition was communicated to the exchange via a Regulation 30 general update filing on 29 June 2026. The consideration amount, payment structure, and strategic rationale were not disclosed in the headline announcement; full details are expected in the formal exchange filing and company press release.
